explication: EGM is an AI-assistant plugin for developing ideas into specifications and reviewing documents with fresh reviewers. The documented workflow runs from brainstorming and human agreement, through drafting, then staged review and human approval; skills can also be used independently for codebase bootstrap, drift reports, finding resolution, or configured review loops. The graph follows README-documented behavior; skill internals and most host integrations were not sampled. The repository also contains a static documentation site, whose Markdown-link transformation is visible in sampled source.
